selection_basis: Metadata only: previously unused basic/icing/representative stations on the same three routes, grouped in nearby corridors outside the original 23 training stations. No outcome or availability based reselection.
thresholds: Original competition14 Ice model retains its existing threshold. Thermal rule: estimated temperature <=0 and dewpoint >= estimated temperature or prior3h rain>0 or ASOS snow>0. No new threshold search.
gate: Prepare every planned ten-minute prediction and seal models, inputs, plan and source before any new station observation request. Open outcomes once, report all eight stations including missing/undefined states. Never tune using these outcomes.
primary_comparison: Same valid Ice rows, complete-day and event denominators; both FP and FN must fall for a joint improvement claim. Temperature uses shared finite rows and station macro MAE/RMSE. Report weather distance, coverage, response-coordinate differences and station-specific failures.
limitations: Spatial generalization only: same winter, existing weather network and stations outside Jeonbuk. Not an independent future-winter or official score.
Metadata does not establish independent sensors, historical availability or conditional distribution stability.
Honam pair is nearly colocated; report station and group counts separately.
First request time and complete prediction seal establish prospectivity; local hashes alone are not third-party proof.
